arguments.message:
Hi there,

Annual renewals normally use the account’s current list price unless a specific renewal price was locked in when the original quote was agreed. If you think the renewal charge doesn’t match the price you were quoted, the billing team will need to compare your contract or order form with the amount that was charged.

Please have the account owner or billing contact open a support request and reference the original quote. We’ll then review the terms for your account and let you know whether a price adjustment or refund is possible.

Thanks for reaching out!
